# ④ The Smart Factory

[Brand Design](http://patrickszot.webflow.io/older-work/the-smart-factory#)

[Art Direction](http://patrickszot.webflow.io/older-work/the-smart-factory#)

The Smart Factory virtualizes manufacturing processes to optimize productivity and simplify decision-making. The Crux Design System is a visual system bound by natural transformation and man-made virtualization. It combines wondrous natural landscapes and the man-made nature of modern computing. At its core is a script which 'virtualizes' natural imagery and translates them to intricate graphic motifs. These motifs, in tandem with human-centric/tech-centric photography, form the foundation of Crux Design System.‍
